Jobs iii (dose) and iv (furnace end point) learn only from their calibration flakes and receive no labelled data afterwards: frozen by construction in the paper's harnesses, so frozen = online trivially; their calibration-size curves are in part B.

## B. One generic model or specialists at the edge station

### Accuracy, bytes and time per station (test seeds 1-20)

G = one generic connectome model at its defaults; P = one tuned connectome model per job sharing the measured wiring (flag 2.5 % with context, stop with gain control, dose 10 %, furnace 5 % code); E = engineered specialists.

| | G generic | P per-job connectome | E engineered |
|---|---|---|---|
| flag new phase / wrong sample (AUROC) | 0.966 / 0.991 | 0.973 / 0.992 | 0.986 / 0.997 |
| stop a failing run (flakes lost) | 3.55 | 3.30 | 3.40 (C 10); 3.90 (C 1) |
| dose (share on target; error) | 0.952; 5.5 % | 0.972; 5.1 % | 0.883; 8.2 % |
| furnace end point (flakes lost) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.10 |
| packed bytes | 259.9 kB | 323.6 kB (four separate wirings: 764 kB) | 9.4 kB |
| µs per spectrum, all four jobs (one Grace core) | 222 | 395 | 9.2 (S24) |

### Setup cost: settings tuned and labelled examples to reach 95 % of the paper result

Settings: what each option tunes to reach its reported number (grids of S23). Examples: from the curves below.

| job | G generic | P per-job connectome | E engineered |
|---|---|---|---|
| flag | G: none (defaults; context gain fixed at 2) | P: sparsity x context gain (9) | E: none (z-score); routing needs the sample log, as G and P |
| stop | G: none | P: sparsity x gain control (9) | E: C (5) for logistic regression |
| dose | G: none | P: sparsity x gain control (9) | E: ridge lambda (5) |
| furnace | G: ridge lambda on the code (5) | P: ridge lambda on the code (5) | E: ridge lambda (5) |

Total settings tuned: G 1 (5 candidates), P 4 jobs x 2 settings + 1 (41 candidates), E 3 (15 candidates).

### Fit on a Raspberry Pi Pico (264 kB SRAM, 2 MB flash) and Pico 2 (520 kB SRAM, 4 MB flash)

All in RAM = packed bytes + working arrays (one drive per code family); with flash = read-only parts (wiring, stored codes, regression weights) in flash, RAM holds only what is written at run time.

| option | packed | all in RAM | Pico | Pico 2 | RAM with flash | Pico | Pico 2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| G generic | 259.9 kB | 283.3 kB | no | yes | 29.9 kB | yes | yes |
| P per-job, shared wiring | 323.6 kB | 370.5 kB | no | yes | 53.4 kB | yes | yes |
| P per-job, four wirings | 763.8 kB | 810.7 kB | no | no | 53.4 kB | yes | yes |
| E engineered | 9.4 kB | 9.6 kB | yes | yes | 8.7 kB | yes | yes |

Generic model, all in RAM on a Pico: fits with flag, stop, dose, furnace, flag+stop, flag+dose, flag+furnace, stop+dose, stop+furnace, flag+stop+dose, flag+stop+furnace; all four jobs need 283.3 kB.
